purpose: Test one compact causal interpretation produced by complete visual review of the 1,765-chart BEAR slow-supply-exhaustion book: stock-level supply exhaustion should be actionable only when same-day broad market repair is already observable, and a repeatedly lost frozen platform should end the trade.

market_state.long_horizon_state: Exact pre-existing causal market_regime must equal BEAR on the signal date.
market_state.same_day_repair_universe: On the signal date, include only rows whose bar is PIT available by decision_at and whose hard_valid, current_valid, current_day_data_tradable, market_rule_valid, corporate_action_valid, historical_identity_valid are true; trade_status equals 1; corporate_action_blocking is false; corporate_action_count equals zero; is_st is false; and step_return is finite.
market_state.same_day_repair_rule: Cross-sectional median step_return > 0 and fraction of eligible rows with step_return > 0 > 0.50.
market_state.causal_timing: Both repair measures use only completed signal-date bars available by approximately 15:30. They contain no future return and can first affect the following legal open.

stock_candidate.source: Exact frozen BEAR_SLOW_SUPPLY_EXHAUSTION_TAKEOVER candidate ledger; no candidate feature, lookback, threshold, or cooldown change.
stock_candidate.frozen_level: Signal-date prior5_high already stored in the candidate ledger.

execution.entry: First legal buyable coordinate open during signal cal_idx +1 through +3, preserving coordinate lineage.
execution.profit_exit: After the entry session, if a legal observed coordinate high reaches entry_price * 1.10, fill at the target price.
execution.failed_acceptance_observation: After entry, count consecutive valid completed closes with coordinate close strictly below frozen prior5_high. A close at or above the level resets the count. Missing or invalid bars fail closed and do not create a false observation.
execution.failed_acceptance_trigger: The second consecutive below-level valid close creates a pending exit after that close.
execution.failed_acceptance_fill: Fill the pending exit at the earliest subsequent legal sellable coordinate open. Never fill on the trigger close.
execution.time_exit: After twenty holding sessions, fill at the earliest subsequent legal sellable coordinate open under the pre-existing H20 convention.
execution.priority: At each new session, fill an already-pending failed-acceptance or time exit at the legal open before considering that session's high. Otherwise a +10% target reached intraday takes precedence over any new close-based trigger created later that day.

comparison.baseline: Exact frozen candidate with its original +10%/H20 replay.
required: return delta versus exact mother on the identical filtered candidates
